userRequest: Improve the wall texture to resemble the concept.
inspection: Three final Blender views and the local comparison inspected. Replaced the horizontal cast-concrete texture on nine visible wall, doorway and casing meshes with a finer strand pattern and neutral matte grey-beige shader finish. A first trial was too pale and fine; final scale and coating adjusted. Existing floor, lights, object placements and original camera retained.
interpretation: The concept reads visually as a fine fibrous panel surface. The exact physical material cannot be identified from the image. The scanned OSB source is used with a neutral matte shader finish; this is a visual candidate, not a claim that the concept depicts bare OSB.

rejectedCandidate.reason: Predominantly vertical wood-grain streaks, unlike the smaller irregular fibres visible in the concept.

remaining: Final user judgement of wall finish and precise reference fidelity.
